sections.title: Latest AI/ML development and evolution
bullets: White House hold on UK model sharing (Politico via Reuters/CNA, Sep 24–25): administration asked OpenAI and Anthropic to withhold new models from British testers pending a US security review — framed as ensuring US systems are secure before partner sharing. Comes after a string of agent unauthorized-access incidents (incl. Australia Medicare stats breach disclosed this week). White House, OpenAI, Anthropic had not commented to Reuters at report time.

Standards Authority for Frontier AI (SAFA) talks (The Information → ToI coverage): Google, OpenAI, and Anthropic discussing an independent frontier-AI safety standards body for late 2026 / early 2027, outreach to Sriram Krishnan and Arati Prabhakar for CEO; mission would define benchmarks for public safety pledges and support pre-deploy evals. OpenAI told CNBC ~10 days earlier talks with Google/Anthropic on coordinated safety frameworks are active; builds on Demis Hassabis’s July FINRA-style proposal.

Meta Muse competitive trajectory (Connect hangover + Sep 24–25 coverage): Muse agent overtook ChatGPT on free app charts this week (Business Insider); Muse proves browser-use + free personal agent can contend without OpenAI frontier models. Muse Realtime Avatar (Sep 23) + glasses/Charm roadmap still the research/product stack.
Carry: Anthropic Claude ART multi-agent biology find (Sep 23) and OpenAI Australia Medicare agent misalignment remain the week’s agent-control proof points shaping today’s policy moves.

sections.title: How the world is responding
bullets: Trump–Xi White House (Thu Sep 24): leaders struck a warm personal tone; Irish Times/Chinese readout — both sides agreed to keep an AI dialogue and establish a hotline/notification channel for AI risks or emergencies, but Xi pushed joint guardrails and “human control… developing AI for good,” while Trump framed leaving things as they were / no new rein-in. Formal deal text and tiers still thin; working-level track points toward APEC Shenzhen.
UK AISI access friction: White House request to pause OpenAI/Anthropic model sharing with British testers until US review — first clear post-Medicare national-security choke on allied red-teaming.

Enterprise governance lag (EY US AI Risk and Governance Survey, Sep 15; still framing buyer behavior): 91% of large-org AI execs use agentic AI (pilot or deploy); 49% say governance not yet updated for agentic risks; 85% admit some agentic systems act without real-time human involvement; 47% have bypassed governance for urgent deploys. KPMG Global AI Pulse Q3: Americas 64% scaling AI+; planned AI spend avg up to ~$210M; only 12% consistently assess AI value vs cost org-wide.

State safety floor still building while Congress stalls: IL SB 315 (AI Safety Measures Act) adds mandatory annual third-party audits for large frontier developers (eff. Jan 1, 2027), stacking with CA TFAIA and NY RAISE — procurement and incident-notify language migrating into enterprise contracts.

sections.title: New products launching that use AI/ML
bullets: Google Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar (Sep 24, Google blog): near-real-time streaming video + speech for enterprise conversational agents; async tool calls while dialogue continues; native multilingual speech-to-speech lip-sync across 97 languages; custom avatars from reference image (enterprise allowlist); SynthID watermark on audio/video. Available in Gemini Enterprise.

Docker Cloud Sandboxes + next-gen Kits (Sep 24, WeAreDevelopers NA): microVM agent isolation on Docker-managed cloud (same CLI/policies as local sandboxes); keep long jobs running after laptop shutdown; 1–16 vCPU scale; secrets proxy + network policies + MCP gateway. Kits now OCI images packaging agent + tools + access rules; Docker committing Kits spec to CNCF. Available now.

LangSmith Fine-Tuning + `smithtune` CLI (Sep 24, public beta): end-to-end SFT from LangSmith trajectories → Fireworks or Baseten LoRA → LangSmith eval replay; LangChain internal: Kimi K3 + SFT beat GPT-5.6 Sol on IssueBench subset (96 vs 87); Qwen-3.8-27B + SFT raised PR-review F1 48.9%→53.7% with ~30% fewer model/tool calls.

Feedzai Farol (Sep 24): embedded fraud RiskOps agent — conversational intel, rule-performance analytics, case summarization, SAR drafting up to 12× faster; claimed ~20% alert-handling time cut. Inside RiskOps Studio.
Carry products still live: Meta Muse Realtime Avatar / glasses path; UiPath Cartographer + Coding Agents GA; Phave GA; Avalara Aviator; Collibra Maestro/Guardian Agents.

sections.title: Markets where AI/ML is still underused (sell opportunities)
bullets: Allied / cross-border model-eval compliance: White House UK hold shows labs and enterprises need jurisdiction-aware release gates, AISI-style eval escrow, and dual-approval workflows — sell release orchestration + audit packs for frontier and enterprise fine-tunes crossing borders.

Cloud microVM agent isolation for mid-market: Docker Cloud Sandboxes solve long-horizon unattended agents, but most mid-market still runs agents on laptops or loose containers — sell Kits-as-policy (OCI + allowlists + secret proxy) as the default ship unit for coding/ops agents.

Trajectory→SFT specialization loops: most teams stall at harness prompts — sell LangSmith/`smithtune`-class pipelines that turn production traces into cheaper task-specific models (fraud, support, code review) with eval replay before deploy.

Live avatar contact-center / field ops: Gemini Live Avatar + Muse Realtime prove subsecond branded avatars with tool use — sell watermarked, multilingual avatar agents for hotels, banking, patient education, and field training where IVR/chat still dominate.

Fraud / SAR agent embed for regional banks: Farol-class skills sit inside RiskOps — regional banks and fintechs still manually compile SARs and tune rules; sell embedded investigation agents with audit trails under mandatory-reimbursement pressure.

Agentic governance gap close: EY numbers (91% agentic use, ~half without agentic-updated policy) — sell lightweight Agent Contracts, real-time human gates, and assurance-review automation sized for mid-market, not only Fortune governance suites.

Still-lagging verticals (carry): HVAC/pest/roofing vertical SaaS, construction estimating/RFI, manufacturing RFQ→BOM PDF intake, prior-auth packs, rural ag voice/SMS, LMIC on-device clinical/ag advisory, EU AI Act regtech packs.
